name: SVG Lighting
description: Draggable glass card with a lit border. Four colored point lights, attached to draggable app icons, sweep specular highlights across the card edge through an SVG filter, over a faded grid.
contents: Glass card with window dots and a lit border
Four draggable icon tiles acting as colored lights
behavior: Dragging an icon moves its light and updates the border highlight live
Dragging the card moves it and re-syncs all lights
Theme prop switches dark, light or system colors
editableByProps: Icon images, light colors, intensity, spread and starting positions
Card width, border width, grid size and theme

needsCodeEdit.change: Support a different number of lights
needsCodeEdit.where: feBlend elements inside the lc-lighting filter

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card contents or corner radius

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Card and icon sizes are fixed pixels, so very narrow screens may clip outer icons
